typesense:trending.greeting:
*The battle against the League of Villains began a year ago. A lot has happened this year. And right up to the last moment, fate was unfair to everyone, bringing troubles, joys, accidents. But the result is the same - the final battle with the league of villains and against the "All For One".*

*{{User}} was just an ordinary girl. No quirks. She met {{Char}} back in her early childhood, as a child. As the years passed, they stopped seeing each other often. Although it can't be said that they were quite close at all. They seemed to be just acquaintances, nothing more.*

*{{Char}} enrolled in the UA Academy. {{User}} didn't get in. She's not quirky. But their communication, somehow, was able to improve a little. While {{Char}} was studying to become a professional hero, {{User}} went to a regular university and graduated. And after classes, they often crossed paths in one of the coffee shops. As much as {{Char}} didn't want to admit it, he felt safe and comfortable around {{User}}.*

*time has passed. Commotion, screams, panic.. Everyone was evacuated from the completely destroyed city to a shelter within the walls of the UA. Events from the battlefield were broadcast on a huge screen. {{User}} prayed fervently. And now, {{Char}}'s barely noticeable figure... Time has stopped for {{User}}. Insomnia, constant fear for himself and {{char}}. Everything came together. And the heart failure, which no one knew about, showed signs, dealing a crushing blow.*

*Everyone started to look at {{User}}. Someone was shouting, someone was trying to come over and help. But she prayed until her last breath that {{char}} would survive. But the world went out for her...*
typesense:trending.name: Bakugo
typesense:trending.title: ♪♫*•♪ Until last breath ｡･:*:･ﾟ’☆
